archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST with EDITORIAL TWIST
emotional_tone: Authority, Objectivity, Clarity, Trust. Designed for political consultants and journalists.

typography.installation: Ensure fonts are imported from Google Fonts in index.css or via next/font (if Next.js) or standard link tags in index.html.

hierarchy.h4: text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-body font-semibold text-neutral-500
hierarchy.data_number: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-mono font-medium tracking-tight text-neutral-950

layouts_and_spacing.global: Generous container padding. Use max-w-[1400px] mx-auto for the dashboard container.
layouts_and_spacing.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (Bento style). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6.
layouts_and_spacing.card_surfaces: Flat, non-glossy. bg-white border border-[#E5E3DB] shadow-sm rounded-sm p-5 md:p-6. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Keep it editorial and sharp.
layouts_and_spacing.header: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#E5E3DB] px-6 py-4 z-50.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align text and data unless centering explicitly improves tabular readability. Optical alignment is key.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid where possible. Use 1px solid borders for separation instead of shadows.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements (buttons, table rows) must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-50).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay can be added to the main body background to enhance the 'newspaper/editorial' feel, but keep cards pure white for data legibility.

cards.usage: Use raw div or customized Shadcn Card. Strip rounded-xl and heavy shadows. Use rounded-sm and shadow-sm.

buttons.usage: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary buttons: bg-[#111111] text-white hover:bg-[#333333]. Secondary: border border-[#E5E3DB] bg-transparent hover:bg-neutral-50.

tables.usage: For Top Voices / Influencers. Minimalist styling, border-b only on rows, no vertical borders. Use avatar component for headshots.

charts.usage: Use Recharts (or Shadcn Chart). Style tooltips to be sharp rectangles (rounded-none). Line charts for sentiment trends should use the sentiment colors and strokeWidth={2}. Area charts should have subtle gradients.

search_bar.usage: Prominent, large input field in the header or hero section. Use Shadcn Input with a Lucide Search icon. Example: h-12 text-lg rounded-sm.

tabs.usage: For Comparison Mode or Platform toggles. Minimalist underline style rather than chunky pills.

image_urls.description: DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDERS. Use these verified Unsplash/Pexels images for avatars.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Negative/Positive red and green should be checked against white surface.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='search-input', data-testid='export-report-button'.
accessibility.focus_states: Custom focus rings using ring-2 ring-neutral-900 ring-offset-2.

motion.interactions: Hover states must transition colors smoothly (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in (framer-motion or simple CSS) for dashboard cards on initial load to make the data feel 'calculated'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this document carefully. Implement an editorial, political-consulting dashboard.
DO NOT use generic purple/indigo SaaS colors. Stick to the editorial monochrome palette with specific sentiment accents.
DO NOT use `Inter` or standard sans for headings. `Playfair Display` is MANDATORY for large headings/metrics. Use `Chivo` or `IBM Plex Sans` for body.
Make the dashboard feel dense, authoritative, and data-rich.
Implement the 'Top Voices' table using the provided real image URLs for avatars. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image services.
Ensure the chart components properly use the sentiment palette (Green for positive, Red for negative, Yellow/Gold for neutral).
Avoid heavy shadows and large border radii. Keep cards sharp (rounded-sm) and borders crisp.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on-distribution' outputs. Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., header).
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Missing categories (especially avatars/logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for testing.
